components.text:
No reading habit, or no liking for books.
Too busy at work.
No time, because of the internet, games, TV and phones.
components.attribution: The three main reasons for not reading listed by the 23rd National Reading Survey. The share giving each reason was not published.

notes: These are the reasons non-readers gave in the survey, the top three: no reading habit or no liking for reading, being too busy at work, and no time because of the internet, games, television and phones. After those come not finding interesting books, no reading atmosphere, not knowing what to read and having nowhere to read. The release does not give each reason's share, so we quote the words and do not rank them by size.
